title: security-rbac-v2-enforce-kms-region-pinning-audit-hardening
author: Priya Rao
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning via RBAC v2 policies
Add structured audit events for KMS operations including region and key metadata
Migration guide for existing KMS bindings and policy updates
description: Motivation: tighten KMS usage controls and improve audit fidelity for regulated customers. This PR enforces region pinning for KMS keys via RBAC v2, hardens audit logging to include key id, key region, and resolved effective role, and adds migration tooling to update legacy KMS bindings. Changes include a new RBAC policy matcher for kms:region constraint, enforcement hook in the RBAC v2 enforcer, structured audit event schema changes, and a small admin UI flag to surface mismatched residency. Checklist: - [x] Add RBAC matcher and unit tests - [x] Hook enforcement into request pipeline - [x] Emit structured audit events for KMS operations - [x] Integration tests for multi-region scenarios - [x] Docs and migration guide - [x] End-to-end QA on staging Notes: this is targeted at customers using Redwood Private and Dedicated deployments that require strict data residency. The enforcement is opt-in behind a feature flag by default but will be scheduled for gated rollout after customer notifications. Backwards compatible behavior: when the policy is enabled, any request that attempts to use a KMS key outside the allowed region will be denied; when disabled, the enforcer logs an audit event with severity=warning. See linked Linear items for rollout plan and SEC ticket for support runbook.
